goblinBiology.sex: All goblins are male. No female goblins exist in this world.
goblinBiology.reproduction: Goblins reproduce by breeding with females of other races (primarily humans, elves, etc.). Offspring are always goblins.
goblinBiology.notes: Consistent with Goblin Slayer canon. Any prior references to female goblins are retconned. All goblins encountered are male.

generalRules.adultContent: All sexual and breeding content involves adults only (18+).
generalRules.playerSpecies: Azra began as an ordinary male goblin and is now an athletic hobgoblin variant.
